sqwebmail_pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the sqwebmail daemon.

sqwebmail_debug_login.description: Debug level for login diagnostics. 0=off, 1=on, 2=on+log passwords.

sqwebmail_maildirpath.description: Directory name of the maildir directory.

sqwebmail_loggeropts.description: Courierlogger options, e.g. to set syslog facility.

sqwebmail_cache_clean_minute.description: The minute (0-59) at which the sqwebmail cache cleaner cron job runs.
